notes.title: Patch Update [version: 2.0.0b18 / Build id: 19795990]
notes.content: [p]The app has been updated to 2.0.0b18. [/p][p]\[Changes][/p][p]- The method for detecting the captured area has been updated. [/p][p]This will reduce the chance of cropping the captured area failing.[/p][p]It is no longer dependent on the background color or frame drawing status. The default setting has been switched to the new detection method.[/p][p]If you would like to use the old detection method, please change it in the advanced settings. [/p][p][url="https://vrhandsframe.eurekaworks.jp/docs/settings/advanced#capture-area-detection-method"]https://vrhandsframe.eurekaworks.jp/docs/settings/advanced#capture-area-detection-method[/url][/p][p][/p][p]This update affects the core of the app. If you experience any issues due to this change, please report them to ⁠Discussion.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Additional Features][/p][p]- Added GIF animation capture function.[/p][p][/p][p]When photo mode is selected, you can capture GIF animation images by holding down the capture trigger button. To end animation recording, release the trigger.[/p][p]GIF animation related options and an achievement have also been added. [/p][p][url="https://vrhandsframe.eurekaworks.jp/docs/settings/photo/#gif-animation-capture"]https://vrhandsframe.eurekaworks.jp/docs/settings/photo/#gif-animation-capture[/url][/p][p][/p][p]  [img src="https://vrhandsframe.eurekaworks.jp/assets/images/capture_animation-951295ac7f7adc86a375ea133b667f20.webp"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]\[Other][/p][p]- The image size (volume) is now displayed on the panel (when the date and time display is enabled).[/p][p]- You can close all panels by holding down the close panel button. [/p][p]- Minor bugs have been fixed. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks. [/p][p][/p][p]Eureka Works [/p]

notes.title: Patch Update [version: 2.0.0b13 / Build id: 16273388]
notes.content:
Updated the app to 2.0.0b13.

[Settings]
 [list]
[*] Added "Force processing with incomplete frame" to Advanced Settings.
When this setting is ON, image processing will be attempted even if the entire frame is not visible.
Cropping accuracy may be reduced. The default is OFF.
[*] Added resolution-related settings to system settings
[*] Moved panel-related settings to separate tabs (Panel)
[/list]
[Bug Fix]
Fixed issue where window was not stored in task tray when deactivated immediately after launching

Thanks.

Eureka Works

notes.title: Minor Update [version: 2.0.0b12 / Build id: 15999986]
notes.content:
The app has been updated to 2.0.0b12.

[UI]
[list]
[*] Changed to hide desktop window in task bar when inactive or minimized.
You can also switch to always-on display from system settings.
[*] Stabilized the app's rendering process
[/list]
[Photo]
[list]
[*] Added option to minimize image deformation [β]
Ignores affine transformation processing when cropping an image. Default is OFF.
This reduces image quality degradation, but if the frame is distorted from an exact rectangle, the crop area may be unexpectedly reduced or rotated.
[/list]
[Fix]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where icons could be switched when reading a 2D code
[*] Fixed other minor bugs and internal processing
[/list]

If you find any problems, please post them discord or Steam discussions.

Eureka Works
